generation_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production game sky texture, opaque RGB PNG, EXACTLY 1024x512 pixels, 2:1 equirectangular full sphere panorama.
Input image: the Winter Expansion concept sheet is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY; use panel 8 Northern Lights Skybox for palette and broad aurora curtain shapes. Create a separate sky-only texture.
Primary request: deep midnight navy/blue winter sky, sparse small readable stars, broad sweeping stylized green/cyan northern lights with restrained violet on a few upper fringes. Quiet retro low-poly Places aesthetic, simplified painted ribbon curtains, no photoreal noise.
Projection contract: U spans full 360-degree yaw and wraps seamlessly at left/right. V runs from zenith at top row to nadir at bottom row; horizon is EXACTLY halfway down, row 256. Put all aurora bands in the upper hemisphere between rows 80 and 225, leave clear dark-blue atmospheric horizon near rows 235-270. Below the horizon is featureless deep blue fading darker toward nadir. Uppermost and lowermost 16 rows are featureless uniform navy to avoid pinching at the poles. Left and right edges must match perfectly, with aurora gently continuing through the wrap, no border.
Composition: 2 or 3 large readable sinuous curtain bands distributed around the upper hemisphere, curving folds with green lower edges and cyan softened upper edges, modest violet accents. Broad bands, sparse stars in empty blue areas. Gentle light falloff, smooth gradients without banding, lightly faceted forms matching the reference. Brightest aurora below 65% display brightness; dark sky remains dominant.
Constraints: SKY ONLY. No mountains, trees, ground, buildings, water, landscape silhouette, moon, sun, text, labels, concept-sheet panels, borders, or watermark. Never reproduce the sheet layout. Opaque background. Precisely 2:1 output.
final_edit_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Redesign this sky texture for a game: the current aurora looks MUCH TOO LARGE, CLOSE-UP AND SOFT when wrapped onto the sky. Make the aurora look DISTANT and crisper.
Output a sky-only opaque 2:1 equirectangular spherical panorama. Prefer exactly 1024x512 pixels.
Critical composition coordinates (normalized image): horizon y=0.5; zenith y=0.0. Place THREE slender, elegant distant aurora arcs ONLY between y=0.22 and y=0.38. Every arc should be just 0.025 to 0.045 image-height thick (13-23 pixels in a 512-high image). Do NOT create huge tall vertical curtains. Small short folds are allowed within the narrow ribbon. Keep the entire y=0.40..1.0 area free of aurora: quiet midnight blue. Keep y=0.0..0.15 clear midnight navy. At least 80 percent of the panorama must be quiet dark night sky.
Aurora arcs: gracefully sinuous horizontal bands receding into the sky, subtle green lower edge blending to cyan, VERY restrained faint lavender fringe on one arc only. Crisp clean stylized painted shapes and refined curved edges with a few simplified folds, no giant blurry pillars. Narrow distant flowing ribbons not towering close curtains. Balanced low contrast, restrained brightness, no white clipping or neon flood.
Stars: sparse tiny sharp single-point stars scattered only y=0.16..0.44, discrete little pinpoints not blurry blobs. Deep blue navy sky with smooth gradients and no gritty noise, no blocky giant pixels, no posterization.
Wrap constraints: leftmost and rightmost 10 percent both remain the same quiet dark blue gradient, no stars or aurora touching the edges. Smooth transitions into artwork, no abrupt vertical join. Top and bottom 5 percent featureless uniform navy to avoid pole pinching.
Retain the retro low-poly Places mood while making the sky more composed and readable at distance. No ground, mountains, trees, buildings, moon, text, borders or scenery. SKY ONLY.
resolution_edit_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: 2:1 equirectangular game sky PNG. Input image 1 is the edit target. Increase actual rendered image resolution to 4096 x 2048 pixels. Preserve this composition exactly: distant narrow sweeping green/cyan aurora ribbons only between y=0.22 and y=0.42, very restrained lavender fringe, at least 80% quiet deep navy sky, clear dark uniform poles and matching quiet left/right wrap margins. Maintain the same small apparent angular scale of the aurora, no oversized close-up curtains. Stylized retro low-poly environment compatible art. Tiny sharply defined star points; clean smooth broad readable bands with crisp luminous lower edges, gentle limited glow, no photographic noise, haze, grain, blur or smeared tiny detail. No landscape, clouds, objects, text or moon. Opaque RGB. Maximum spatial resolution is essential because a small portion covers a whole game viewport.
